summary: Backend-only testing of LOTR 5e Travel System journey calculation. All 13 tests passed. The COORD_TO_KM = 20 fix has been verified - Hobbiton to Esgaroth now correctly returns ~824 km (previously was ~264 km). Pathfinding is using roads correctly when preferir_caminos=true, and days are calculated based on terrain costs from the pathfinder.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Journey calculation endpoint POST /api/travel/calculate-journey verified working. Key constants: COORD_TO_KM=20 (km per coordinate unit), BASE_SPEED_KM_DAY=36 (base travel speed). Hobbiton-Esgaroth test case: ~824 km distance, ~45 days, terrain breakdown shows facil/moderado/dificil/muy_dificil terrain types with km distances.
